# Use a new migration gate when uplift skipped older migrations

The release channel had recorded migration50 before migrations48/49 shipped, so their older gates no longer ran. This repair raises the checkpoint to 51 and repeats only search-integration synchronization and the old XULStore list-view conversion under<51. Fixed source retains that gate; a new profile skips prior migrations. This is a specific release-order repair, not proof arbitrary migration tasks are idempotent. Upgrade verification is attributed to historical QA, not this run.

Scope: Use a new migration gate when uplift skipped older migrations.
